title: Compliance Memorandum: Company Nonrenewal of Owner Auto Policy Terms
content:
**Grounds.** The company nonrenews an Owner Auto Policy term only for a reason on its nonrenewal reason list, chiefly when no package's renewal points maximum is met.

**Notice lead time.** A nonrenewal notice is valid only when its mailing date is at least the garaging state's nonrenewal notice days before the expiration date. Those days are in the state pages. This is read from the notice's mailing date, the term's expiration date and the term's garaging state.

**Late notice.** When the notice could not be mailed in time, the company issues the renewal in the highest package the drivers qualify for, and may nonrenew at the next expiration.

**Effect.** A nonrenewed term runs to its expiration date and moves to expired. No renewal term is issued.

**Lead-time check (hypothetical, Ohio, 30 days).**

| Expiration | Notice mailed | Valid |
|---|---|---|
| 31st of a month | 1st of the same month (30 days before) | Yes |
| 31st of a month | 2nd of the same month (29 days before) | No; the renewal is issued |
